title: Module coefficient clause of hypercover cohomology
statement: The module coefficient clause of thm-weil-pbc-hypercover-cohomology: for every qcqs scheme X, q and ring R, FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover.IsCohomologyColimit (ModuleCat R) q (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat R)) 0 ⋙ Etale.cohomology (ModuleCat R) X q).

proof.text: The corresponding coefficient-category comparison follows by the injective-resolution double-complex argument, successive finite refinement corrections, and the colimit universal property described in the parent theorem.

lean.statement: theorem hypercover_cohomology_module_part (X : Scheme.{u₁}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (q : ℕ) (R : Type (u₁ + 1)) [Ring R] : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover.IsCohomologyColimit (ModuleCat.{u₁ + 1} R) q (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u₁ + 1} R)) 0 ⋙ Etale.cohomology (ModuleCat.{u₁ + 1} R) X (q : ℤ))
